decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also utilizing efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out games. With a combination of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and maintain control of the board throughout the game.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger abilities and deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven combos to generate consistent value and control the board. Mayhem Devil deals damage whenever a permanent is sacrificed, providing a strong win condition. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute allow for stealing and sacrificing opponent's creatures, while Fatal Push and Thoughtseize provide disruption. The deck also includes various lands that support its strategy, along with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to further enhance its sacrifice synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn along with a variety of multicolored cards to control the game and outvalue opponents. With a mix of removal spells, card draw, ramp, and powerful threats like Omnath and Valki, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a diverse range of spells from different colors. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for powerful toolbox options, while the companion Yorion provides additional value and versatility. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to adapt to different situations and consistently generate advantage over the course of the game.

The focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up green mana through devotion, utilizing cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic. The deck aims to play aggressive creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, supported by cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provides versatility and resilience against opponents. Lair of the Hydra and Cityscape Leveler offer additional win conditions, making this deck a powerful and efficient aggro/devotion archetype in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck is focused on aggressive gameplay, aiming to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It utilizes aggressive creatures such as Kari Zev, Skyship Raider and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage early on. The deck also includes burn spells like Play with Fire and Stoke the Flames to remove threats or finish off the opponent. Atarka's Command and Reckless Bushwhacker provide additional burst damage and pumping power to the team. The deck makes use of land cards like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to enhance its aggression and maintain a fast pace.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and lock down the opponent with Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown. The deck also aims to ramp up mana quickly using Fires of Invention and powerful lands like Triomes. With a mix of creatures with powerful abilities and control elements, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up a strong board presence to eventually overwhelm them. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a Companion adds an additional card advantage engine to the deck.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to create a recurring sacrifice engine with Mayhem Devil to deal damage to the opponent's creatures or face. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute help steal or sacrifice opponent's creatures for value. Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional aggressive threats, while Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal. The deck also includes some land choices that provide additional benefits when sacrificed, such as Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant.

This Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing out low-cost creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Shacklegeist to apply pressure on the opponent. By using cards like Rattlechains to protect important creatures and counter spells with Lofty Denial, the deck aims to maintain tempo and control of the game. Spell Queller is used to disrupt the opponent's plans while cards like Curious Obsession help draw extra cards and maintain card advantage. With a mix of evasion, disruption, and card draw, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence with spirits while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal. By utilizing efficient creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, along with card draw from Curious Obsession, the deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game. Cards like Shacklegeist provide additional control options, while Supreme Phantom boosts the power of the spirit creatures. Overall, the deck aims to outpace opponents through aggro tactics and strategic disruption.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on aggressively sacrificing creatures to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil, Witch's Oven, and Cauldron Familiar to create a constant stream of damage and advantage. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute allow for stealing and sacrificing the opponent's creatures for additional value. With a mix of removal spells and disruptive cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice effects and synergies between cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional value. The deck's aggressive playstyle is supported by cards like Claim the Firstborn and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also having a recursive threat in Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using small, efficient creatures that work well together. By utilizing cards like Brave the Elements and Thalia's Lieutenant, along with the support of cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ossification and Coppercoat Vanguard provide additional ways to maintain board control and push through damage, making it a powerful Aggro-Weenie White deck in the Pioneer format.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering spells, board wiping, and generating incremental card advantage with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Omen of the Sea. It also utilizes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to flicker permanents for additional value. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence with difficult to remove threats like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants. With a mix of counter magic, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents until it can close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent using a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures in the Rakdos color combination. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and apply pressure with threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also has some synergy with graveyard recursion and additional reach with Kroxa and cards like Reckoner Bankbuster. Overall, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Voyaging Satyr, and Lotus Field to cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. By utilizing cards like Dark Petition and Hidden Strings, the deck aims to set up explosive combos and find key pieces like Thespian's Stage and Bala Ged Recovery. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City to protect key spells and maintain board presence. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling powerful combinations to overwhelm opponents in a fast-paced manner.
